journey.name: Lift: a free session takes a program day
journey.description: A free session does a day of a program instead of composing each set: the programs on a sheet under its Next set card, a day's sets up next once one is picked, and the session logged as that day. A day of a program not followed counts for none; the followed program's next day, taken this way, moves it on as Start day N does. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval).

actions.action: On "Set up", which a fresh install opens on, tap "Skip for now"
Tap the "Train" tab, which opens on "Strength", then "Start session"
Verify that the session shows "Next set" and, under its card, "Do a program day" over "Pick a day of any program to do now"
Verify that a sheet titled "Program days" lists programs under "Built-in", "Your first 100 swings" among them, and no "Your programs" group
Scroll to "Your first 100 swings" and tap it

Verify that the sheet is titled "Your first 100 swings", with "All programs" above "Day 1", "Day 2" and "Day 3", each over "Deadlift · Two-hand swing" and about how long it takes, and that none is marked "Next"
Verify that the session shows "Up next · 1 of 12 sets" with a figure doing the deadlift over "Deadlift", "Today's plan", and neither "Next set" nor "Do a program day"
Verify that Strength still shows "Follow a program": the day done was of no program followed
Tap "Follow a program", scroll to "Your first 100 swings", tap it, then tap "Follow this program"
Verify that Strength shows "Day 1 of 12 · week 1"; scroll to "Free session" under "On your own" and tap it
Verify that the sheet lists "Your first 100 swings" under "Following", above "Built-in"
Tap "Your first 100 swings" on the sheet and verify that "Day 1" is marked "Next"
Verify that "Up next · 1 of 12 sets" is shown; tap "Log set", then "Finish", then "Done"
Verify that Strength shows "Day 2 of 12 · week 1"
